intent_snapshot.goal: Make exhaustive dependency-aware decision-tree clarification the default interaction protocol in both imm-brainstorm and imm-planner without adding a Skill, mode, runtime state machine, or UI. Brainstorm owns product framing decisions and Planner owns execution-design decisions; both investigate repository facts themselves, ask the complete currently unblocked frontier in rounds with numbered recommendations, allow a zero-question fast path, retain only final decisions, and require an explicit final summary confirmation. Planner returns product-level uncertainty to Brainstorm. Preserve roundtable and adversarial as orthogonal lenses, preserve direct Planner entry for clear requests, repair the repository's pre-existing Managed Path bootstrap markers/headings, and align source, packaged contracts, legacy contract tests, and the active Brainstorm behavior benchmark with the complete-frontier protocol.

acceptance.assertion: The source and packaged imm-brainstorm and imm-planner contracts define the default exhaustive decision-tree protocol, complete-frontier rounds, repository-fact self-resolution, phase-specific decision ownership, zero-question fast path, recommendation/bulk acceptance behavior, result-only persistence, explicit final confirmation, and Planner-to-Brainstorm return for product-level uncertainty; the root bootstrap files satisfy the Managed Path markers and Project Context heading; the legacy Brainstorm probing contract and active behavior benchmark no longer enforce fixed question counts or one-at-a-time dependent probing.

evidence.summary: Final expanded-scope implementation verified. Focused contract command `bun test tests/exhaustive-decision-tree-contract.test.ts tests/brainstorm-decision-probing-contract.test.ts` passed 10 tests, 142 assertions. Full canonical `bun test` passed 959 tests, 4326 assertions, 0 failures across 131 files. `bun scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts --check` reported all generated packaged docs in sync. Active benchmark fixture now uses dependency-aware complete-frontier scenario IDs/prompts/checklists and the legacy contract test rejects all prior fixed-budget/serial scenario tokens.

approvals.summary: Immutable bundle provenance is valid, and the bounded contract, bootstrap, test, and benchmark changes correctly implement the default exhaustive decision-tree behavior without identified regressions.
